value.rationale: The result supplies a complete natural count-by-production distribution for infinitely many crossed strips and a sharp finite-support topological-defect identity. Boundary rewiring leaves exponentially many bulk *counts* invariant while changing exceptional phases according to n modulo four. This is a structural separation of bulk and seam behavior not implied by the already-known prism polynomial; it is not an arbitrary finite computation or incremental n extension.
